description: If any thread panics while holding the OPEN_PATHS mutex lock, the mutex becomes poisoned. All subsequent calls to open_paths().lock() will return Err, and the code converts this to LmdbError::Other("OPEN_PATHS lock poisoned"). Since OPEN_PATHS is a process-global OnceLock<Mutex<...>>, a single panic during an LMDB open will permanently prevent any future LMDB open in the process. The PathGuard::drop also silently ignores a poisoned mutex (if let Ok(mut set) = open_paths().lock()), meaning the path is never removed from the set (if it was even added before the panic). This could leave the process unable to open LMDB at all after a panic recovery attempt. Consider using a RwLock or catching the poison error more robustly.
title: lmdb: OPEN_PATHS mutex poisoning causes all subsequent opens to fail permanently
